data.text:
LOOK: Homeowners of Villa Integridad Subdivision in Brgy. Suklain, Arayat, Pampanga hold a peaceful rally in front of the Pampanga Provincial Capitol on Monday, September 8, urging the provincial government to intervene in their land development issue allegedly stalled by politics and technicalities. 

Residents protested the Arayat Municipal Government’s closure of the subdivision’s office over alleged technicalities, despite the developer having secured permits, ongoing site work, and legitimate land titles for most owners. 

They called on Pampanga Gov. Lilia Pineda to act under the new Ease of Doing Business ordinance, which advocates say is vital to restoring investor confidence following recent illegal POGO scandals in the province. 

📸: Santi San Juan | MB
